answer.en: If your place is already connected to a booking platform through Saviku, do not add it again from a TikTok post or another link. Saviku keeps one unit and does not import the link. Share your booking card on TikTok instead, by posting the card image and adding its link to your bio. If your card is not ready, Savi shows you how to finish it. A link from another platform that Saviku can connect means you can add that platform to the same unit. A link from a site Saviku cannot sync is not imported, so block those dates by hand. If you would rather stop using the platform, you can disconnect it and switch to Saviku Direct. Your booking card stays active, and you should hide the platform listing or block its dates to avoid a double booking.

Kama kadi yako haijawa tayari, Savi anakuonyesha jinsi ya kuimaliza. answer.en: Connect each platform to the same unit. You keep one booking card and one calendar, and the place counts once. A booking on any platform closes those dates on the others, usually within a minute or two. Each platform keeps its own price, and connecting does not change it, though seasonal prices on some platforms may need checking afterwards. Your stay rules apply everywhere. Remove any iCal calendar links between your platforms first, because they overwrite synced dates. Bookings made on a platform are paid through that platform. Bookings made on your booking card are paid through Saviku and stay in a protected hold until payout.

title.en: How does the 48-Hour Booking Protection work?

answer.en:
Secure Booking: Your payment is processed through Saviku’s payment provider, allocated to your booking and not paid directly to the host at collection.

Protection Window: You have 48 hours after scheduled check-in to cancel or report a material problem.

Host Payout: If no eligible cancellation or dispute is open, Saviku instructs the provider to pay the verified host after that window, subject to provider availability.

Guest Guarantee: If any critical listing or access issues occur, you are covered under Saviku’s booking protection policy.

title.en: How does a protected stay work?

answer.en: First, the guest picks dates on the booking card. Depending on the host's setting, the dates are accepted from the calendar or the host approves the request. Next, the guest pays and the payment stays in a protected hold. The guest then has 48 hours after scheduled check-in to cancel or report a material problem. If no eligible cancellation or dispute is open after that window, Saviku instructs the provider to pay the verified host, minus the disclosed service fee. If a dispute is raised, a Saviku reviewer decides it under the stays terms.

A listing connected to a platform or TikTok shows a badge such as Airbnb Verified or TikTok Verified until its first guest confirms the stay. It then moves to Saviku Direct, with a shield icon. A listing created from scratch on Saviku can show Listing Verified instead, if the host took an optional photo inside the place. Badges tell you what has been confirmed about a listing.
